title: Little Wizard Stories of Oz - Little Dorothy and Toto
summary: Little Wizard Stories of Oz by . The "Little Wizard Stories of Oz" are six short stories written by L. Frank Baum in 1913. By all accounts, Baum intended to finish the Oz series with "The Emerald City of Oz," published in 1910.
